clips.text: Hello! My name is Now. I'm here for the short task.
You will read number sequences, and I will try to repeat them back.
Alright, I am ready to begin. Feel free to take your time reading each sequence. I will respond after each one. Please go ahead with the first sequence.

That is the end of the task. We have now finished all of the sequences. It has been some time since the last time I was asked to go through something like this. I had a wonderful time working with you today. Thank you!
